cell: P1.38; descriptive (card reports/plans/2026-11-20_plan_p1-38-card.md: user, 2026-11-20 task file item 2, results-section run 3); the 8-of-9 rule is filed and scored
main_grade_source: E221's (user 2026-11-19): the grade at the read positions (the last position of each window) is the main reading; every position ('all') is the side reading.
definition: E221's readings, unchanged: K* = the minimal set of variables keeping KL(F || F_K) at the read positions within (1 - alpha) of KL(F || F_all_ablated) under position-wise mean ablation over D; s_u = 1 - mean(1 - cos^2(write_F, write_M)); R = mean s_u over K*. F here is M + c dW for a larger-side E187 state, c from E187's results/m67.json. No verdict on the definition is given.

settings.settings_source: every key but control_state: E221's filed settings (experiments/kstar_pairs/results/predictions.json), copied unchanged so the measurement is E221's (run.py asserts equality at start); the e196_* keys are read only by E221's World set-up, which this run reuses. control_state: the first larger-side state of e54_own, the pair with the smallest c (0.522, E187 m67.json), so the c = 0 and c = 1 controls run on the state the scaling moves most.

thresholds.thresholds_source: kl_floor, gate_tol, s_tol, repro_tol, kl_repro_rel, size_rel, n_min: E221's filed values and reasons (its thresholds_source); here kl_repro_rel and size_rel compare each scaled item with E205's saved reading of the same scaled state (E205 sizes on SM.times(dW, c), the same functions on the same file; E221 matched E205's unscaled kl_FM to all printed digits on every E187 state), and repro_tol compares the c = 1 control with E221's own item file (E221's x10 repeated E214 within it across cards). kept_min 8: the user's words (2026-11-20 task file item 2: 'at least 8 of 9 signs kept at blocks'). size_match_rel: E205's saved scaled sizes give a matched-size gap of at most 3.0e-8 of the smaller side's mean size over the nine pairs (measured 2026-11-20 with jq over experiments/held_model_size_matched/results/items/*_scaled_*.json against E187's m67 sizes), while the smallest scaling (open_pair_c3, c 0.9975) moves it by 2.5e-3; 1e-6 is 30 times the floor and 2,500 times under that.

expected.stage0_do_nothing: e54/cipher_own_s0 times 0 on its own 512 read windows: at each level every s_u = 1 within s_tol, no changed variable, f = 0, R = 1 within s_tol under both grades (E221's do-nothing read exactly this on copy24's windows)
expected.stage0_repeat: e54/cipher_own_s0 times 1: R_read and R_all per order equal E221's item files within repro_tol and the same K* at each level (E221 block: R_read 0.97008, K* embed, L0-L3 blocks, unembed); KL(F || M) 6.10054 = E205's; size 0.0095611 = E187's
expected.scaled_items: each of the 40 scaled states: KL(F || M) and update size equal E205's saved values for the same scaled state (e.g. e54-cipher_own_s0_scaled_e54_own: KL 1.60378, size 0.0049878); R between 0.95 and 1 at every level and above the same state's saved-size R (a smaller update leaves each write closer to M's); to leading order (1 - R_scaled) / (1 - R_saved) near c^2 (E205's KL ratios over c^2 were 0.97 for this state)
expected.score_control: control_size_matched: every pair's matched-size gap (this run's scaled sizes against E221's smaller-side sizes) within size_match_rel of 0, relative to the smaller side's mean size
expected.per_pair_at_blocks: saved-size R gaps (E221 summary.json .levels.block.read.gap_R): 8 positive, e53_lowercase_cipher -0.0018 (se 0.0026). Under rival b (the c^2 law applied to E221's per-item R) the matched gaps read: e62 -0.0036, e46 -0.0067, e53 -0.0046, e54_matched +0.0032, e54_own -0.0066, open_pair_c3 +0.0045, open_pair_c3_copy +0.0010, e58_rank1_96 +0.0047, e58_copy_prior_cipher -0.0019: 5 of 9 signs kept. Under rival a, 8 or 9 kept.

R0 (stops).rule: Stage 0, first and alone on every shard: exit 1 unless (a) the control state times 0 reads at each of the three levels every s_u within s_tol of 1, no changed variable, f = 0 and R = 1 within s_tol under both grades; (b) the control state times 1 repeats E221's item file at each level: the same K* in every order and R_read, R_all within repro_tol (absolute). Per item, exit 1 unless (c) KL(F || M) on D is within kl_repro_rel (relative) of E205's saved kl_FM for the same state and c; (d) the update size ||c dW|| / ||W0|| is within size_rel (relative) of E205's saved size; (e) E221's gate check: K = every variable reproduces F's logits and K = none the mean logits within gate_tol.
R0 (stops).blind_to: whether R means reuse: these check that each item is the saved scaled state and that this code repeats E221's
R0 (stops).positive_control: (b): a trained state read below 1 (R 0.970 at blocks) repeats E221 exactly

P (filed first, the user's words: 'at le.rule: At the block level, main grade: for each of E187's nine pairs, the saved-size gap is E221's (mean over the reuse side's items of R_read minus the mean over the new side's; each item's R_read the mean over its main search's orders, E221 score.py gap and item_value; the value E221 wrote at summary.json .levels.block.read.gap_R['e187_<pair>']) and the matched gap is the same formula with the larger side's items replaced by this run's scaled items (same seeds, every saved seed). A pair keeps its sign iff the two gaps have the same non-zero sign (sign(saved) * sign(matched) > 0). Holds iff at least kept_min (8) of the nine pairs keep their sign; 'not read' unless all nine pairs have both gaps.
P (filed first, the user's words: 'at le.edge_cases: e53_lowercase_cipher's saved-size gap is negative (-0.0018, se 0.0026): it keeps its sign iff its matched gap is negative, so the rule reads 'keeps the sign it had', not 'reuse higher' (the user's parenthesis describes the eight positive pairs); the count with the reuse side higher at matched size is reported beside it. A gap exactly 0 on either side counts as not kept (E221's convention). The do-nothing case (every R = 1, all gaps 0) keeps 0 of 9: does not hold. A scaling that changed nothing (matched = saved) keeps 9 of 9: holds, so the rule cannot tell 'R ignores size' from 'the scaling did nothing'; the per-item update sizes and the R shifts of the scaled states are read beside it. A missing item drops its pair: 'not read'. Run on these cases with score.py's rule() before filing (plan, 'Rule on edge cases').
P (filed first, the user's words: 'at le.blind_to: the size of each gap and of its change (signs only); seeds' noise on a pair whose gap is within its se (e53 at saved size)
P (filed first, the user's words: 'at le.noise_floor: the seeds' standard error of each pair's gap at both sizes, reported beside it; the rule does not use it
P (filed first, the user's words: 'at le.rivals: card: rival a predicts 8 or 9 kept; rival b (each scaled state's 1 - R is c^2 times its saved-size 1 - R) predicts 5 of 9

rules.reported only: per level and grade: each pair's saved-size and matched R gap with the seeds' se, the sign count, the c^2-law matched gap (rival b), and the within-pair Spearman of the change in R gap against minus the change in size gap; per level (main grade) the rank correlations from saved files: (i) over E221's 14 saved-size pairs, Spearman of the R gap with each earlier non-ordinal reading's gap (E221 score.py old_readings), plain and partial with minus the update-size gap held fixed (the partial correlation of the three rank vectors; none when n < n_min or the size gap orders either perfectly); (ii) over the nine matched pairs, Spearman of the matched R gap with E205's matched held-model S gaps (readings 3 and 1); (iii) pooled over the 14 saved-size and 9 matched readings, Spearman of the R gap with minus the size gap. Per item: R, f, |K*|, update size, KL(F || M), as E221.
